status_at_freeze: sealed Study 2 complete; no candidate-specific timing-closure search run
purpose: Validate the single-5-ns WNS-derived frequency metric against fresh constraint-driven timing closure without changing sealed Study 2.

immutability.revision_rule: Preserve v1 and create a separately named preregistered study for any justified protocol change.

population.common_support_rule: Design has at least one emitted correct-candidate record in sealed_sft, pooled sealed_rf_s1/sealed_rf_s2, and sealed_mlp_s1.
population.family_rule: Use the frozen family field in fmax_manifest.json.
population.design_rule: Within each represented family, select the design minimizing lowercase SHA256('closure-v1|' + design).

candidate_rule.sft: Select the compiled candidate closest to the count-weighted conditional mean old proxy frequency within the selected design.
candidate_rule.rf: Compute each available RF seed's count-weighted conditional mean, average seed means equally, then select the compiled pooled-RF candidate closest to that target.
candidate_rule.eligibility: The old PPA row must exist, compiled must equal 1, fmax_mhz must be finite and positive, count must be positive, and emitted file/hash must verify.
candidate_rule.tie_break: Ascending absolute distance, then source_sha256, then module name.
candidate_rule.duplicate_rule: The ten selected materialized byte streams must have distinct source identities; otherwise select the next ranked eligible candidate in the same arm/design or fail manifest generation.

flow.constraint_order: Read the candidate and clock/I-O XDC before synth_design.
flow.fresh_run: Every requested period uses a new process and clean trial directory.
flow.closed_rule: Synthesis and implementation succeed, exactly one named clock exists, at least one setup path exists, no unconstrained timing path is reported, routing is clean, and WNS is nonnegative.
flow.failure_rule: A repeated tool/parse/constraint/route failure is retained, assigned closure frequency zero for endpoint accounting, and makes completeness fail; it is never dropped.

superseded_preflight_draft_manifest.status: Generated during no-Vivado dry-run, then superseded before any candidate trial when the required synthetic capability preflight was added.

required_checks: report_timing_summary -report_unconstrained -check_timing_verbose is supported and all named unconstrained/coverage counts are zero
ROUTE_STATUS filtering is supported and finds no unrouted nets
clock, setup-path, and constraint-coverage checks pass

preserved_initial_failure.reason: The first synthetic probe established that XDC if statements and the proposed get_timing_paths/get_input_delays/get_output_delays query forms are unsupported in Vivado 2023.1. No Study 2 candidate had been run. The retained check_timing report identified the supported replacement.

preserved_second_failure.reason: The second synthetic probe passed constraint coverage but get_timing_paths -setup returned empty while the retained Design Timing Summary reported 51 setup endpoints and WNS 7.501 ns. The supported replacement parses that authoritative report row.

capability_preflight.pinning_rule: The final manifest hashes the runner, probe, final attestation, both preserved failed-attempt attestations, closure Tcl, all retained logs/reports through the attestations, and every other workflow script.

search.nonmonotonic_rule: Repeat contradictory periods once. Persistent tighter-pass/looser-fail behavior fails the candidate; no favorable pocket is selected.

criteria.complete_and_constrained: All ten candidates have valid monotone brackets and confirmed boundaries; no permanent, unconstrained, or nondeterministic result.
criteria.spearman_ge_0_90: Pooled candidate-level Spearman rho between old proxy and conservative closure frequency is at least 0.90.
criteria.median_smape_le_0_15: Median symmetric absolute percentage error is at most 0.15.
criteria.paired_direction: Mean representative RF-minus-SFT closure difference is positive and no more than one non-tied pair reverses relative to the old proxy; old-proxy differences within 1 percent are ties.

publication_extension.full_sample_rule: After a pilot pass, extend to all 15 common-support SFT/RF representative pairs plus the unselected minimum and maximum old-proxy candidate in each family, 40 distinct raw inputs total.
publication_extension.full_gate_summary: Require zero invalid results, rho >= 0.90 with cluster-bootstrap 95% lower bound >= 0.80, median sMAPE <= 0.15, 90th percentile sMAPE <= 0.30, at least 13/15 non-tied pair orderings preserved, and positive paired RF-minus-SFT mean with 95% lower bound above zero.

stop_rules: Do not start a long Vivado run until manifest.json, manifest.sha256, materialized inputs, dry-run output, and unit checks have been reported.
Do not freeze the final manifest unless the non-Study-2 capability preflight passes and its attestation is included in the dependency hashes.
Do not change selection, thresholds, search bounds, or failure scoring after any closure result is inspected.
If the pilot fails, preserve it and stop new comparisons whose physical endpoint depends on the old metric until the measurement issue is resolved.

If rank/calibration fails, do not fit a post-hoc calibration to rescue the headline; either close every primary raw source and regenerate the endpoint or label it only as a single-request timing proxy.
If the RF effect disappears or reverses under closure, the current TCAD efficacy headline is unsupported and must be reframed or replaced.
